outcome_note: Founders: "several project leads and key members of the Community Council"; Oracle kept its employed developers. openSUSE 11.4 and Fedora 15 (2011) ship LibreOffice in place of OpenOffice.org; the name went to Apache OpenOffice, which still releases (4.1.17 on its news page).
Fedora: MariaDB was "founded by some of the original MySQL developers"; Oracle kept the MySQL team and name. Fedora 19 and Wikimedia replaced MySQL; MySQL continues under its name.
The creator (Kohsuke Kawaguchi) and the community vote (214 to 14) went to Jenkins; Hudson's later steward, Eclipse, wrote that Hudson is not maintained and Jenkins is its replacement.
io.js's committee were Node.js core team members and alumni; Joyent kept the name. The lines reunited under the Node.js name on io.js's codebase (Node.js 4.0.0).
Founders were engineers "across a number of companies" (vendors); HashiCorp kept its team. No independent downstream replacement was checked.

Founders include long-standing Redis contributors and a former maintainer (Madelyn Olson, AWS); Redis Inc kept its team and the name. Fedora replaced Redis with Valkey, for licence reasons; Redis added AGPLv3 in 2025 and continues.
"a team of former Gitea maintainers"; Gitea Ltd's owners were Gitea maintainers too. Codeberg (the custodian) uses Forgejo; no independent downstream was checked.
Mass resignation of volunteer staff, who founded Libera; "abandonment by multiple high-profile projects" (LWN). freenode still runs under its name.
"a group of community members and former employees" carried the project to the Linux Foundation; no rival line.
Change of steward by acquisition; calls to fork by July 2021 (Hackaday). The arm cannot be fixed because the fork's first release was not dated.
Abandonment and handover; the new maintainer was accepted without contest until the malicious dependency was found, and npm then took the package over. No rival line.
